purpose: Decision-reconciled growth proposal. G22/G26 now recommend bounded resumable validation, segmented source facts, explicit compact Merkle commitment refinement and retained current-schema generations feeding G27/G28. New owner acceptance and production conformance remain required. Preserve archive authority, approved current-schema hard-cut scope and Alembic forward-only infrastructure. G38/G39 now recommend reference-based whole-scope observation inputs, bounded metadata/read-view execution, independent incremental acceptance and scoped original evidence; new envelope/ABI/cap details remain recommended pending owner review.

notation.N: Member count of the exact selected collection or stream; not a configured maximum.
notation.B: Useful selected plaintext/data bytes; reading/writing/encrypting distinct required bytes costs work even when data is identical.
notation.b: Bytes requested by a particular range/read.
notation.D: Encoded request/result/configuration/plan/path metadata size, with output accounted separately where it grows.
notation.H: Encoded unique required provenance within the exact operation scope. Internal retransmission/re-expansion is not new necessary H.
notation.V: Unique provenance or workflow vertices/records relevant to the stated graph operation.
notation.E: Explicit necessary declared relationships/edges. Materializing a transitive/member-history cross product does not redefine E.
notation.O: Required archive objects/parts/segments; crypto packaging overhead disclosed rather than assumed to be O(1).
notation.Q: Results explicitly requested by the public operation, not intermediate rows gratuitously generated by the implementation.
notation.Z: Retained size of the specific indexed domain relevant to this operation; unrelated total server data is not always Z.
notation.p: A page/batch/window capacity; held fixed in a growth experiment, and recorded as an execution condition.
notation.P: Recipe/predicate definition size or explicit task count; fixed for collection-axis claims, independently varied in program-axis tests.
notation.R: Admitted retry/restart attempts under the stated failure model; unbounded failures do not imply finite completion.
notation.Copies: Number of explicitly requested archive copies/destinations.
notation.T: Number of retained tags for the tag operation only.
notation.Ap: Encoded applicable authorization/policy expression size, not all policies in the service.
notation.I(k,Z): Explicit indexed access allowance O(k log(2+Z)) for fixed-width keys; variable key-byte cost must be added. Not strict linear total work.
notation.S(k): One explicitly required deterministic ordering O(k log(2+k)) comparisons; charge compared key bytes for unbounded strings. Already ordered traversal is linear.
notation.J(D): JCS property ordering: O(sum over objects of k_i log(2+k_i) key comparisons), plus compared UTF-16 key bytes; parsing/emission O(D).
notation.kappa: One KDF cost at declared fixed security parameters; security parameters cannot be lowered to meet a growth/timing target.
notation.X(profile,frames,samples,resolution): Component-owned media/tool processing cost for a supported fixed execution profile; not a generic Riverhog file-count guarantee.
notation.H_U,V_U,E_U: Unique bytes/vertices/edges in the exact union of selected history required by one operation; all permissions and selection fences remain in force.
notation.D_scan: Publicly defined searchable input domain/encoded content for a full-scan query, not the chosen query plan's accidental intermediate product.
notation.A_direct: Directly declared or semantically required member-attribution links for the approved compact discovery profile; not an automatically expanded transitive closure.

family_defaults.closure_bindings: Resolve to exact existing operation/schema/Python/CLI elements during integration; these family IDs are proposal identifiers.
